repos_data.description: Local-only Go static analysis engine with a built-in MCP server. Gives AI coding agents deterministic structural awareness: call graphs, impact analysis, symbol search, and more.
MCP for semantic code search & navigation that reduces token waste
Free, MIT alternative to paid Django schema review. Blast radius on every PR, schema drift, N+1 across functions, ER diagrams, MCP server. No DB, no Django boot, no Pro tier.
17 MCP query tools for codebase navigation — functions, classes, imports, dependency graphs, change impact. Zero dependencies. 87% token reduction.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
Fast local MCP server for deterministic cross-service API-chain discovery across REST, GraphQL, Kafka, TypeScript, and FastAPI.
